I work at Zeta

zeta... the fintech play that's actually making money. building payment infrastructure while everyone else is still figuring out unit economics.

found tushar thakur on linkedin - SRE at zeta. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/thakur-tushar
Yessir

sre at zeta... keeping the payment rails running while everyone else is breaking things. that's some serious infra work. 

what made you get into the sre game? most people run away from on-call, you ran towards it

Haha yes, i was always fond of systems and computers and when i learnt about how computers run in cloud i was very fascinated by it. So i chose that as my optional subject in my engineering and learnt about cloud computing, and eventually found a role as cloud engineer at a cloud service based startup in Bangalore,i.e Euphoric Thought Technologies, learnt hands on about monitoring and how to handle basic outages. I was curious to learn more and started to explore kubernetes and landed a job at Zeta soon after that

euphoric thought to zeta... from learning the ropes to running production at scale. that's a proper sre journey. kubernetes curiosity paying off big time.

what kind of role you looking for next?

In my current role, I’ve handled on-call responsibilities extensively, including mitigating high-severity incidents, reducing downtime, and automating a lot of manual operational tasks. I’m confident in those areas.
For my next role, I’m looking for something that gives me deeper technical ownership ideally in Cloud development, DevOps, or Platform Engineering where I can work on scalable systems, build automation, and apply more of my design and innovation skills.
That said, I’m flexible and open to roles that blend SRE, on-call readiness, and technical development, as long as there’s clear scope for growth and learning.

sre to platform engineering... classic evolution. you've done the firefighting, now you want to build the systems that prevent the fires. smart move.

Thanks
  Open for all

3 years experience + platform/devops focus + open to all cities but bangalore preferred... sound right?

Thanks

done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yes
  Thanks a lot

you're all set, legend! welcome to the tal network.

time to level up that career. the good stuff starts flowing now.
